task: Implement the next P3 backend slice on completion/model-library, preserving commit 0df436f1dfbb639fba55169909661e54f9abd132. Add a unified bounded local model-source layer for Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp/GGUF: typed source/backend identity, loopback-only discovery probes with explicit unavailable/error states, normalized model metadata/digest/size/family/parameter/quantization/context fields, and search/filter-safe records. LM Studio and llama.cpp endpoints must be configurable only to loopback addresses; GGUF file imports must be constrained to an app-managed model root and never arbitrary paths. Distinct quantizations/digests must remain distinct immutable competitors. Wire Tauri commands and bridge functions for unified discovery and source-aware profile registration, persist records and provenance in the model-library store, and add focused Rust/TypeScript tests for endpoint validation, adapter parsing, source identity, GGUF bounds, discovery failures, and duplicate grouping. Run cargo fmt/check/test, npm typecheck/test as relevant, git diff --check, then create one focused local commit. No UI/download/removal implementation in this turn beyond typed command seams; no merge/tag/release/deploy/public release.
